text:
alex: quick check — i'm about to change the chart so the app picks up SERVICE_TOKEN from either an explicit secret (values.service.tokenSecret) or falls back to the projected serviceaccount token file. wondering which pattern folks prefer and whether any infra TF changes are needed.

maria: +1 to prefer explicit secret when present. for Helm i'd recommend using `lookup` to detect the secret and conditionally render the env stanza rather than trying to jam file-path logic into an env var.

maria: example (very small):
```
{{- $s := lookup "v1" "Secret" .Release.Namespace .Values.service.tokenSecret | default nil }}
{{- if $s }}
- name: SERVICE_TOKEN
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef:
      name: {{ .Values.service.tokenSecret }}
      key: token
{{- else }}
- name: SERVICE_TOKEN_FILE
  value: "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token"
{{- end }}
```
This keeps intent explicit: if there's a k8s Secret we pull it, otherwise consumers can read the file path.

kevin: nit — prefer `value` vs `valueFrom` depending on secret shape. also watch for chart consumers that expect `SERVICE_TOKEN` env var specifically (so might need same var name in both branches). example tweak:
```
{{- if $s }}
- name: SERVICE_TOKEN
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef:
      name: {{ .Values.service.tokenSecret }}
      key: token
{{- else }}
- name: SERVICE_TOKEN
  value: "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token"
{{- end }}
```

sam: infra note — i'm also changing TF to create the `k8s_secret.service_token` resource for prod. it's gated behind the feature flag so rollout is manual. i'll add a `depends_on` for the k8s deployment resource so we don't race. cc @maria if lookup logic will see it immediately or if we need an extra sync step.

maria: lookup reads live API, so once TF applies the Secret it should be visible to Helm in the next deploy. if you're doing an in-place helm upgrade in the same pipeline, make sure terraform apply completes before helm upgrade step (or add a short wait / `kubectl get secret -n $NS $NAME --ignore-not-found` loop).

infra-bot: CI pipeline update: https://ci.example.com/builds/9821 — terraform apply (prod) scheduled on approval. :rocket:

alex: perfect. i'll update chart template to use the conditional pattern, keep var name the same in both branches as kevin suggested, and add a note in values.yaml documenting the fallback. i'll also add a tiny unit test for the template rendering in the chart-ci job.

sam: pinged you for CR. thanks! :thumbsup:
